en.t: Ah, forget it, I will just have to make do.

units.source_text: 清清爽爽的道道青光，沿着洞穴的边缘透进来，这次，倒过来，自己得同那濡湿海绵般的困倦作斗争。

en.t: Clear, fresh streaks of blue light came filtering in along the rim of the hole; this time, the situation was reversed, and he had to struggle against a drowsiness like a soaked sponge.

units.source_text: 只要这种恶性循环不在哪里截断下来，不仅是手表，怕是连时间本身都要被沙的粒子弄得动弹不得了吧。

en.t: Unless this vicious circle was cut off somewhere, it would not be only the watch; even time itself might be pinned down by the grains of sand, unable to move.
